sentences.en: This camel is so tame that anyone can ride it.
sentences.zh: 这头骆驼如此温驯，任何人都可以骑。

sentences.en: Sami realized it wasn't easy to tame his hidden desires.
sentences.zh: 萨米意识到他难以控制自己隐藏的欲望。

sentences.en: She tried to tame her flowing locks with a hairband.
sentences.zh: 她试图用发带把散乱的头发束起来。

phrases.zh: 努力使...变得温和或受控

senses.zh: 驯服的；乏味的；顺从的；平淡的 -
